stem:
At a store each notebook has a cost of x dollars. Which situation can be represented by this inequality?

5x < 3x + 2

options.label: A
options.text: The cost of 5 notebooks is greater than the cost of 3 notebooks plus a $2 pen.

options.label: B
options.text: The cost of 5 notebooks is less than the cost of 3 notebooks with a $2-off coupon.

options.label: C
options.text: The cost of 5 notebooks is less than the cost of 3 notebooks plus a $2 pen.

options.label: D
options.text: The cost of 5 notebooks is $2 greater than the price of 3 notebooks.
